## Descriptive analysis 

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

# Seleccionar variables de interés
variables_interes <- covid %>% 
  select(age, polimed, delta, charlson, quintil, sex)

# Resumen estadístico
summary(variables_interes)


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("ANÁLISIS DE EDAD\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

# Estadísticos descriptivos
cat("Media:", mean(covid$age, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Mediana:", median(covid$age, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Desviación estándar:", sd(covid$age, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Mínimo:", min(covid$age, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Máximo:", max(covid$age, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Rango intercuartílico (IQR):", IQR(covid$age, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Percentil 25:", quantile(covid$age, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Percentil 75:", quantile(covid$age, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

# Categorización de edad
covid$age_cat <- cut(covid$age,
                     breaks = c(0, 40, 60, 75, 100),
                     labels = c("<40", "40-60", "60-75", ">75"))

print(table(covid$age_cat))
print(prop.table(table(covid$age_cat)) * 100)
```

```{r}
cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("ANÁLISIS DE POLIMEDICACIÓN\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

cat("Frecuencias absolutas:\n")
print(table(covid$polimed))
cat("\nProporciones:\n")
print(prop.table(table(covid$polimed)) * 100)

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("ANÁLISIS DE EVENTO (delta)\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

cat("0 = Censurado (sin evento)\n")
cat("1 = Reinfección\n")
cat("2 = Muerte\n\n")

print(table(covid$delta))
print(prop.table(table(covid$delta)) * 100)

# Crear variable más descriptiva
covid$event_type <- factor(covid$delta,
                           levels = c(0, 1, 2),
                           labels = c("Censored", "Reinfection", "Death"))

print(table(covid$event_type))

```

```{r}
cat("\n============================================================\n")
```

```{r}
grid.arrange(p5, p6, ncol = 2)
```

## Competing risks

```{r}
library(cmprsk)
# Incidencia acumulada básica
ci_result <- with(covid, cuminc(stime0, delta))

# Ver resultados con más detalle (10 puntos temporales, 2 decimales)
print(ci_result, ntp = 10, digits = 2)

# Análisis de incidencia acumulada
with(covid, cuminc(stime0, delta))

# Imprimir con más detalle
with(covid, print(cuminc(stime0, delta), ntp = 10, digits = 2))

# Gráfico mejorado con personalización
with(covid, {
  ci <- cuminc(stime0, delta)
 ci2 <- ci[grep("1 1", names(ci))] # Survival curve

  plot(ci2, 
       ylim = c(0, 0.05),
       yaxt = "n",  
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence",
      # main = "CIF for reinfection ",
       col = c("blue"), 
        curvlab = "" ,
       lwd = 2
  )
  
  axis(2, at = seq(0, 0.05, by = 0.005), las = 1)
  
  # Añadir grid para mejor lectura
  grid(nx = NULL, ny = NULL, lty = 2, col = "gray90")
 legend("topright", legend = "", bty = "n", col = "white", lwd = 0)
})


```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

with(covid, {
  ci <- cuminc(stime0, delta)
  ci2 <- ci[["1 1"]]
  
  df <- data.frame(time = ci2$time, est = ci2$est)
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = time, y = est)) +
    geom_step(color = "blue", linewidth = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 0.050),
      breaks = seq(0, 0.050, by = 0.005)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, max(df$time) + 10),
      breaks = seq(0, 600, by = 100)
    ) +
    labs(x = "Days from day 120", y = "Cumulative Incidence") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = "dashed", color = "gray80"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black")
    )
  
  print(p)
  
  ggsave("cumulative_incidence.png", plot = p, 
         width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
})
```

```{r,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
library(cmprsk)

# ============================================================
# 1. ESTRATIFICADO POR PERÍODO COVID
# ============================================================

# Crear objeto de incidencia acumulada FUERA del with()
ci_period <- with(covid, cuminc(stime0, delta, group = period))

# Ahora sí puedes graficar dentro del with()
with(covid, {
  ci_period_re <- ci_period[grep("1$", names(ci_period))]
  
  plot(ci_period_re, 
       ylim = c(0, 0.25),
       color = c(1, 2, 3),
       lty = c(1, 1, 1),
       curvlab=c("period1", "period2", "period3"),
       lwd = 3, 
       cex = 1.2,
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  title(main = "CIF for reinfection by Covid Period")
})

# ============================================================
# 2. ESTRATIFICADO POR ÍNDICE DE CHARLSON
# ============================================================

covid$charlson_cat <- cut(covid$charlson,
                          breaks = c(-1, 0, 2, 5, 20),
                          labels = c("0", "1-2", "3-5", ">5"))

# CREAR FUERA
ci_charlson <- with(covid, cuminc(stime0, delta, group = charlson_cat))

# GRAFICAR DENTRO
with(covid, {
  ci_charlson_re <- ci_charlson[grep("1$", names(ci_charlson))]
  
  plot(ci_charlson_re,
       ylim = c(0, 0.08),
       color = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
       lty = c(1, 1, 1, 1),
       lwd = 3,
       cex = 1.2,
       curvlab=c("0","1-2","3-5",">5"),
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  title(main = "CIF for reinfection by Charlson Comorbidity Index")
})

# ============================================================
# 3. QUINTIL
# ============================================================

ci_quintil <- with(covid, cuminc(stime0, delta, group = quintil))

with(covid, {
  ci_quintil_re <- ci_quintil[grep("1$", names(ci_quintil))]
  
  plot(ci_quintil_re,
       ylim = c(0, 0.1),
       color = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
       lty = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1),
       lwd = 3,
       cex = 1.2,
       curvlab=c("1","2","3","4","5"),
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  title(main = "CIF for reinfection by Socioeconomic Quintile")
})

# ============================================================
# 4. POLIMEDICACIÓN
# ============================================================

ci_polimed <- with(covid, cuminc(stime0, delta, group = polimed))

with(covid, {
  ci_polimed_re <- ci_polimed[grep("1$", names(ci_polimed))]
  
  plot(ci_polimed_re,
       ylim = c(0, 0.09),
       color = c(1, 2),   
       lty = c(1, 1),
       lwd = 3,
       cex = 1.2,
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       curvlab=c("Polymadication: No", "Polymadication: Yes"),
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  title(main = "CIF for reinfection by Polymedication Status")
})

# ============================================================
# 6. SEXO
# ============================================================

ci_sex <- with(covid, cuminc(stime0, delta, group = sex))

with(covid, {
  cmpsex <- ci_sex[grep("1$", names(ci_sex))]
  
  par(las = 1, font = 2, font.lab = 2, font.axis = 2)
  plot(cmpsex,
       ylim = c(0, 0.1),
       color = c(1, 2),
       lty = c(1, 1),
       curvlab = c("Female", "Male"),
       lwd = 3,
       cex = 1.2,
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  #title(main = "CIF for reinfection by Sex")
})

png("cumulative_incidence_sex.png", width = 2400, height = 1800, res = 300)

# ============================================================
# 8. RESUMEN
# ============================================================

cat("\n=== SUMMARY OF GRAY'S TESTS ===\n\n")

cat("PERIOD:\n")
print(ci_period$Tests)
cat("\n")

cat("CHARLSON:\n")
print(ci_charlson$Tests)
cat("\n")

cat("QUINTILE:\n")
print(ci_quintil$Tests)
cat("\n")

cat("POLYMEDICATION:\n")
print(ci_polimed$Tests)
cat("\n")

cat("SEX:\n")
print(ci_sex$Tests)
cat("\n")

```

### Commpeting risk with hsptime 

```{r}
summary(covid$hsptime)
ggplot(covid, aes(x = hsptime)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "darkgreen", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Time distribution of the hospital",
       x = "Hospitalization days", 
       y = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
ggplot(covid, aes(x = event_type, y = hsptime, fill = event_type)) +geom_boxplot() +labs(title = "Hospital time by type of Event",x = "Type of event", y = "time in the hospital") +theme_minimal() +theme(legend.position = "none")

ggplot(covid, aes(x = event_type, y = hsptime, fill = event_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Hospital time by type of Event",
    x = "Type of event",
    y = "Time in the hospital"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 90, by = 10)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 90)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

```{r,warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(cmprsk)
# Incidencia acumulada básica
ci_result <- with(covid, cuminc(hsptime, delta))

print(ci_result, ntp = 10, digits = 2)

# Análisis de incidencia acumulada

# Imprimir con más detalle
with(covid, print(cuminc(hsptime, delta), ntp = 10, digits = 2))

# Gráfico mejorado con personalización
with(covid, {
  ci <- cuminc(hsptime, delta)
  ci2 <- ci[grep("1 1", names(ci))] # Survival curve

  plot(ci2, 
       ylim = c(0, 0.05),
       yaxt = "n",  
       xlab = "Days of hospital",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence",
       main = "Cumulative Incidence of Reinfection from hospital days",
       col = c("blue", "red"), curvlab="Reinfection", # Colores para reinfección y muerte
       lwd = 2
  )
  
  axis(2, at = seq(0, 0.04, by = 0.01), las = 1)
  
  # Añadir grid para mejor lectura
  grid(nx = NULL, ny = NULL, lty = 2, col = "gray90")
})
```

```{r,warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Imprimir con más detalle
with(covid, print(cuminc(icutime, delta), ntp = 10, digits = 2))

# Gráfico mejorado con personalización
with(covid, {
  ci <- cuminc(icutime, delta)
  ci2 <- ci[grep("1 1", names(ci))] # Survival curve

  plot(ci2, 
       ylim = c(0, 0.05),
       yaxt = "n",  
       xlab = "Days at icu",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence Probability",
       curvlab="Reinfection",
       main = "Cumulative Incidence of Reinfection",
       col = c("blue", "red"),  # Colores para reinfección y muerte
       lwd = 2
  )
  
  axis(2, at = seq(0, 0.04, by = 0.01), las = 1)
  
  # Añadir grid para mejor lectura
  grid(nx = NULL, ny = NULL, lty = 2, col = "gray90")
})
library(cmprsk)

# ============================================================
# 1. ESTRATIFICADO POR PERÍODO COVID
# ============================================================

# Crear objeto de incidencia acumulada FUERA del with()
ci_period <- with(covid, cuminc(icutime, delta, group = period))

# Ahora sí puedes graficar dentro del with()
with(covid, {
  ci_period_re <- ci_period[grep("1$", names(ci_period))]
  
  plot(ci_period_re, 
       ylim = c(0, 0.08),
       color = c(1, 2, 3),
       lty = c(1, 1, 1), 
       lwd = 3, 
       cex = 1.2,
       curvlab=c("Period1", "Period2","Period3"),
       xlab = "Days at ICU",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  title(main = "Cumulative Incidence by COVID Period, ICU time")
})

# ============================================================
# 2. ESTRATIFICADO POR ÍNDICE DE CHARLSON
# ============================================================

covid$charlson_cat <- cut(covid$charlson,
                          breaks = c(-1, 0, 2, 5, 20),
                          labels = c("0", "1-2", "3-5", ">5"))

# CREAR FUERA
ci_charlson <- with(covid, cuminc(icutime, delta, group = charlson_cat))

# GRAFICAR DENTRO
with(covid, {
  ci_charlson_re <- ci_charlson[grep("1$", names(ci_charlson))]
  
  plot(ci_charlson_re,
       ylim = c(0, 0.07),
       color = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
       lty = c(1, 1, 1, 1),
       lwd = 3,
       cex = 1.2,
       curvlab=c("0","1-2","3-5",">5"),
       xlab = "Days at ICU",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  title(main = "Cumulative Incidence by Charlson Comorbidity Index, ICU time")
})

# ============================================================
# 3. QUINTIL
# ============================================================

ci_quintil <- with(covid, cuminc(icutime, delta, group = quintil))

with(covid, {
  ci_quintil_re <- ci_quintil[grep("1$", names(ci_quintil))]
  
  plot(ci_quintil_re,
       ylim = c(0, 0.1),
       color = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
       lty = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1),
       lwd = 3,
       cex = 1.2,
       curvlab=c("1","2","3","4","5"),
       xlab = "Days at ICU",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  title(main = "Cumulative Incidence by Socioeconomic Quintile, ICU time")
})

# ============================================================
# 4. POLIMEDICACIÓN
# ============================================================

ci_polimed <- with(covid, cuminc(icutime, delta, group = polimed))

with(covid, {
  ci_polimed_re <- ci_polimed[grep("1$", names(ci_polimed))]
  
  plot(ci_polimed_re,
       ylim = c(0, 0.05),
       color = c(1, 2),   
       lty = c(1, 1),
       lwd = 3,
       cex = 1.2,
       xlab = "Days at ICU",
       curvlab=c("polyimadication: No", "Polymadication=Yes"),
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  title(main = "Cumulative Incidence by Polymedication Status, ICU time")
})

# ============================================================
# 6. SEXO
# ============================================================

ci_sex <- with(covid, cuminc(icutime, delta, group = sex))

with(covid, {
  cmpsex <- ci_sex[grep("1$", names(ci_sex))]
  
  par(las = 1, font = 2, font.lab = 2, font.axis = 2)
  plot(cmpsex,
       ylim = c(0, 0.09),
       color = c(1, 2),
       lty = c(1, 1),
       curvlab = c("Female: Reinfection", "Male: Reinfection"),
       lwd = 3,
       cex = 1.2,
       xlab = "Days from day 120",
       ylab = "Cumulative Incidence")
  
  title(main = "Late Events by Sex")
})
```

```{r}
library(broom)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(survival)

# Cox model for reinfection (event = 1)
causmod1 <- coxph(Surv(stime0, delta == 1) ~ sex + age + charlson + quintil+hsptime+icutime, 
                  data = covid)

# Extract results
resultados <- tidy(causmod1, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = FALSE)

# Create custom table
tabla_cox <- data.frame(
  Variable = resultados$term,
  Beta = round(resultados$estimate, 3),
  SE = round(resultados$std.error, 3),
  CI_lower = round(resultados$conf.low, 3),
  CI_upper = round(resultados$conf.high, 3),
  Z_stat = round(resultados$statistic, 2),
  p_value = ifelse(resultados$p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                   round(resultados$p.value, 3))
)

# Display table
kable(tabla_cox, 
      caption = "Cox Model for COVID-19 Reinfection",
      align = c('l', rep('c', 6)),
      col.names = c("Variable", "Est.", "SE", "CI Low", "CI Up", "Z", "p"),
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "scale_down"),
                position = "center",
                font_size = 9,
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "2cm") %>%
  column_spec(2:7, width = "1.5cm") %>%
  footnote(general = paste("n =", causmod1$n, 
                          "; Events =", causmod1$nevent,
                          "; C-index =", round(summary(causmod1)$concordance[1], 2)),
           threeparttable = TRUE)
```

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

# Gráfico 1: hsptime normal
p1 <- ggplot(covid, aes(x = event_type, y = hsptime, fill = event_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Hospital time by type of Event",
    x = "Type of event",
    y = "Time in the hospital"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Gráfico 2: hsptime hasta 90
p2 <- ggplot(covid, aes(x = event_type, y = hsptime, fill = event_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Hospital time by type of Event",
    x = "Type of event",
    y = "Time in the hospital"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 90, by = 10)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 90)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Gráfico 3: icutime normal
p3 <- ggplot(covid, aes(x = event_type, y = icutime, fill = event_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "ICU time by type of Event",
    x = "Type of event",
    y = "Time in ICU"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Gráfico 4: icutime hasta 90
p4 <- ggplot(covid, aes(x = event_type, y = icutime, fill = event_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "ICU time by type of Event",
    x = "Type of event",
    y = "Time in ICU"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 90, by = 10)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 90)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Mostrar en 2 filas y 2 columnas
grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
time<-p1+p2+p3+p4
ggsave(
 "time_icuh.png",
plot = time,
width = 12,
height = 5,
dpi = 300)
```
